description: A React component for rendering a dynamic, interactive table within a board view, supporting features like column resizing, grouping, drag-and-drop, and permissions.

methods.name: resizeColumn
methods.description: Handles resizing of a table column, updating view state and persisting changes.

methods.name: hideGroup
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of a group in the table view.

methods.name: onDropToGroupHeader
methods.description: Handles dropping an option onto a group header to change visibility.

methods.name: onDropToCard
methods.description: Handles dropping a card onto another card, possibly moving it between groups.

methods.name: onDropToGroup
methods.description: Handles dropping a card into a specific group, updating properties and order.

methods.name: propertyNameChanged
methods.description: Updates the property option value when renamed.
